title: fix(plugin-security): an organization administrator's update by id is refused before the row is looked up, whatever the id names
body:
Refs #30198

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组织管理员（不持 `adminScope`）按 id 修改授权行时，恢复“先拒绝、不查行”的顺序：无论这个 id 指向能读到的行、读不到的行还是不存在的行，都回答同一个 `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`（“never edited in place”）。按 id 删除不变：读不到的行和不存在的 id 仍回答读取门的 `404`。
- 为什么改：#30165 让组织管理员的 update 先问一次读取，不存在的 id 因此变成 404，打破了 update-by-id 拒绝顺序规则（不依赖行的拒绝要在查行之前做出），main 的 dogfood 分片随之变红（#30198）。“就地编辑”本来就不在组织管理员的权限内，这个拒绝与行无关。
- 风险与回滚：只删掉组织管理员分支 update 前的那次读取；删除、委派分支、兼持 `adminScope` 的组织管理员都不变；放行与拒绝的集合不变，只有这一类拒绝的状态码从 404 回到 403。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `organizationAdminFailure`（删去 update 分支的 `hiddenFromCaller` 调用，以及随之不再使用的这个方法）；`org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts` 里改指向的两处 update 断言。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/update-by-id-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts`，预期全部通过，组织管理员那条对照用例对行和不存在的 id 都是 403。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **An organization administrator's update by id is refused before the row is looked up, whatever the id names.** In `DelegatedAdminGate.organizationAdminFailure` (ADR-0090 D12), the update branch no longer reads the row first. An edit in place is never part of the organization administrator's right, so that refusal does not depend on the row, and the update-by-id refusal order puts it before any lookup. A row, a row the administrator cannot read, and an id naming no row all get one `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with the same sentence and details. The private helper that only that read used is removed.
- **Unchanged.** The read door's not-found still answers a removal by id of a row the administrator cannot read, and of an id naming no row (a verb the administrator holds, judged on the row). The delegated branch is untouched. An organization administrator who also holds an `adminScope` is still judged by the delegated walk, so its update of a row it cannot read still answers the not-found.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/update-by-id-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts` is unchanged. Its control "an organization administrator, who reads the platform grant object, keeps the administration gate's sentence for a row and for no row" is the case this restores.
- Two pins that asserted the not-found for the organization administrator's update now assert the restored rule. Their removal halves are untouched:
  - `org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`:
    - under `group` and `isolated`, the update of a row the caller cannot read and of an id naming no row is one `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, compared whole, while the delete stays the read door's not-found, compared whole;
    - in the `single` control, the update of a row it reads and of an id naming no row is the same whole refusal.
  - `org-admin-assignment-removal-unreadable-row.dogfood.test.ts`: `PATCH` of the row behind the wall and of a missing id answers one `403`, while `DELETE` stays equal to the `GET` of that id.
- `delegated-admin-assignment-write-unreadable-row.dogfood.test.ts` is unchanged. Its organization administrator holds a scope, so it is judged by the delegated walk.

## Acceptance notes

- The unreleased changeset `.changeset/assignment-write-unaddressable-row-not-found.md` says that an organization administrator's edit in place "is asked the same question first". After this PR that sentence is no longer accurate: the edit is refused before any lookup. The new changeset states the rule. The old bullet is left as it stands, so that this fix carries no second changeset correction (which would need confirmation). It wants a one-line correction before the release that ships both.

## Verification

Local readings (the plugin-security typecheck and suite, the posture rig, the three dogfood files, the derived gate families) are taken at this PR's head under the shared verify lock and reported to the seat. CI's families are this PR's own check-runs.
